name: Return to the Crossroads
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from Return to the Crossroads.. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.

You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here.  Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.

Speak with me when you are ready to go.
narrative.objectives: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hah! I guess she liked it! Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!Thank you, adventurer. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you returned from Orgrimmar? Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.
